notes.title: Cave Digger turns 4 years on 9th of May
notes.notes:
Howdy, diggers!

It's been already four years. Can't believe it. On May 9th, 2018, Cave Digger was released as a free game on Steam and that's when our journey as a game development studio truly began! The free version of the game got approximately 100 000 downloads and got us confident enough to develop the game further and eventually release Cave Digger: Riches DLC.

After the train expansion, the PC Edition and several other platform releases we decided to combine the free version on Steam with the DLC content for one premium product. This all allowed us to continue making games and here we are looking at CD2 full release sailing our way slow but steady.

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/devblogs/comments/ilr6zj/cave_diggers_journey_to_all_of_the_vr_devices/]Read more about the Cave Digger's journey on this devblog post on reddit.
[/url]

And here we are, soon (TBD) celebrating the full release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1523510/Cave_Digger_2_Dig_Harder/]Cave Digger 2: Dig harder![/url]

[h2]Cave Digger 2: Dig harder![/h2]

[previewyoutube=kP38UG6uCUA;full][/previewyoutube]

Bigger world to explore, free-form mining in the caves, coop possiblity, interesting tool upgrades, combat and multiple endings (to come).

Cave Digger 2: Dig Harder is a 1-4 player VR adventure game taking place in an alternative weird west dieselpunk world. The player is a Prospector that starts from a small camp, bent on exploring and excavating valuable resources. This allows funding for many things from tools to structures and traveling to new locations. While the Prospector ventures deeper and deeper into the world, they start to discover that someone or something has already been there possibly long before he/she has arrived. And that he/she is essentially on route to track the footsteps of the renowed prospector, Clayton, and the mysteries looming around him.

notes.title: Cave digger 2 community design contest 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32568334/344a5ee2137605690b76134692f83fab6539fed2.png[/img]

Hello from the frontiers of the new country! It’s time for our first community contest for Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! 

We want to include you more into the development process of the game, instead of just choosing your favourites from our designs and what would be a better way to do that than a design contest? You’ll get to showcase your ideas and creativity and we’ll cherry pick the best option(s) and implement it into the game. The winner will also get a copy of Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! on Steam when it becomes available sometime next year. 

[h2]DESIGN A HAT[/h2]
Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! will have character customization, and one of the best ways to make your digger stand out from your friend diggers, is a fancy hat. CD2 takes place in an unexplored valley with rough weather and deep mines in a weird wild west country. A brave digger will need a good selection of hats in such conditions, so there’s definitely room to be creative with your designs. The limitations are that the hat must fit into small caverns and protect the digger from hazardous liquids dripping from the ceilings. So don’t make the brims too wide… nor too narrow. 

First and foremost we’d love to see the designs in the form of art. Drawings, photoshops, 3d models and things like that. Besides that we’d like you to tell us what the hat is called and if it has any background story or other unique details you might think of. The drawings don’t have to be super good, as long as you can get the idea of what the hat looks like. Our artists will be able to fine tune them into something usable in game if needed. If you are absolutely unable to produce anything visual, describe it in the best possible way. However, the visual submissions will probably have a higher chance of winning.

“It wasn't the wearing of the hat that counted so much as having one to wear. Every trade, every craft had its hat.”
― Terry Pratchett, Witches Abroad

That being said, read the rules and start designing! 


[h2]RULES[/h2]

[list]
[*] The hat design does NOT represent any copyrighted material. Things like Iron Man’s helmet or Super Mario’s hat will be discarded. Your design can be inspired by famous hats, but change it a bit just like you would copy your friend’s homework.
[*] The hat design does NOT represent any illegal, hateful, overly violent or explicit content. You know, use common sense.
[*] The design must be submitted by January 3rd, 2021.
[*] The submission must include an image of the design or a detailed written description
[*] One submission per contestant
[/list]


[h2]HOW TO SUBMIT
[/h2]

You can post your submissions to one of these places:

[list]
[*] here in the comments
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CaveDigger/comments/kfivke/cave_digger_2_community_design_contest/?]the reddit thread [/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/cavedigger]Our discord server's #community-contest channel[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: New update - The Unearthly Arrival!
notes.notes:
Odd looking statues have been excavated in the mines. What could they signify? Unveil the mystery to experience the new epic ending, and a reward!

Besides the new mystery around the new ending, the town buildings got some updating. 

[b]The sheriff building[/b] now offers the players quests that they can complete for extra dollars while they're in the mines. Updating the sheriff's building unlocks more quests.

[b]The Saloon[/b] now offers some entertainment for the players and upgrading the saloon unlocks a trophy showcase, which you can fill in by excavating trophies in the mines. 

[b]The reward[/b]: Unveiling the new ending rewards the player with MagnetoGun. Surely the fastest way to mine stuff in the game so far. Just aim at the wall and pull the trigger. You'll see, if the statues find you worthy.

[b]TL;DR:
[/b][list]
[*] A new ending implemented with amazing rewards
[*] Magnetogun tool implemented
[*] The Sheriff offers Quests for the player
[*] The Upgraded Saloon has a showcase for collecting loot
[*] The Upgraded Saloon has a darts board
[*] Vault loot is randomized
[*] 8 new Relics spread across the mines
[*] Vive controller grab fix
[*] Height change button added for all platforms
[/list]


[u][b]About the previous combining of the DLC and the free version:
[/b][/u]
We wanted to clear some things as our announcement regarding the issue turned out to be a bit confusing for some. 
[list]
[*] The Riches DLC and the free version were merged into one package
[*] No game content was removed from anyone
[*] Previous owners of the DLC still get the updates
[*] Previously claimed free versions are still playable as the free version was before the merge
[*] If you want to purchase the new full game, but claimed the free version before, you need to uninstall and remove the Cave Digger from your steam library and then you should be able to purchase the game.
[/list]

If you have any questions or just wanna chat, join us at discord [url=discord.gg/cavedigger]Discord[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32568334/ccf16717dc67030467eabb6205b6116325ab09c8.jpg[/img]

[h1]It was a dark and stormy night[/h1]

The big Halloween special is here! A free content patch for the owners of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/870600/Cave_Digger_Riches_DLC/]Cave Digger: Riches DLC.[/url]

[i]The sun has set and a cold wind blows through the wilderness. Miners of the town gather in the warm saloon to get some good ol’ booze to warm up themselves - as usually. Soon they come to notice that something feels off. The air in the saloon smells weird and the shadows in the corners are eating all the light around... Even the drinks don’t seem to make you feel any better! 

Suddenly the floor of the saloon creaks and a menacing laughter echoes from the mine shaft, followed by a dreaded screeching. Maybe one of the miners is stuck down there in the mushroom caverns? The bravest miner decides to go find out what’s going on. As he jumps on the elevator, he sees a strange looking pumpkin just laying there on a chair. The miner squints his eyes and notices a sign behind the pumpkin, reading: “Eat me!”.[/i]

Eat the spooky pumpkin sitting in the saloon and head down to the mine. A new ending is waiting for you there if you manage to find all 10 pumpkins to decorate your elevator! Watch out for trick or treaters though...

Besides the new ways and things to dig, we’ve also tried to make the game more engaging, entertaining and imaginative. We think that Cave Digger is not just about digging, but also about experiencing surprising things, discovering easter eggs and so on.

notes.title: DLC is on the way to the Frontier, fuelled by community feedback!
notes.notes:
We’ve been happily surprised by all the great feedback that Cave Digger has received during the past weeks. Many of you have been asking if we’re going to continue development, and the answer is yes. We have a lot of cool unused ideas for Cave Digger and the game can still be improved in many ways. 

The future updates will be included in a paid DLC. Even though we’d love to give you everything for free, we still gotta eat and pay our bills. Also this will enable us to continue development. We have already started working on the new content and the DLC will be released later this year. 

The main additions that we’re planning to develop:
[list]
[*]Multiple endings. Some are quite straightforward, some you have to figure out.
[*]Upgradeable gear: You can now upgrade your pickaxe, saw, drill etc. to be more efficient and powerful.
[*]Hidden secrets for the hard worker to discover.
[*]A separate competitive mode to find the hardest worker of them all. 
[/list]

More details about the DLC will be released soon. Stay tuned!

The economic situation on the Frontier might result in changes to the expansion plans. (We reserve all rights to changes.)

Join our discord at https://discord.gg/DYYChfS 
Latest news also in reddit https://www.reddit.com/r/CaveDigger/ 
and facebook https://www.facebook.com/cavediggergame/

notes.title: Patch notes - 16/05/2018
notes.notes:
[*]Candle can now be stickied to walls and rocks
[*]Easier grabbing for explosive crates
[*]Elevator physics bugs fixed with tools and loot
[*]Radio now clears queued transmissions when coming back up
[*]Removed highlight for non-interactable items
[*]Loot Thrower counts oil as well
[*]Baked new light maps and occlusion
[*]Fixed nuke explosion bug when it’s not in the same area
[*]Special floor spawn fix
[*]Start button shouldn’t get lost anymore
[*]Loot Thrower shouldn’t abort anymore when looting new stuff in saloon
